note: P4381 (Pro 30:33) — pressing milk yields curds, pressing the nose blood, pressing anger strife.

dims.v: provoked wrath — forcing anger, which inevitably yields strife
the pressing/forcing of anger — the stirring and provoking of wrath that yields strife as surely as churning milk yields curds and a struck nose yields blood, anger pressed always producing conflict
welded to the conflict pressing anger produces

aph (anger/nose, wordplay) — 'pressing ANGER produces strife' (30:33); as pressure on milk makes curds and on the nose makes blood, so pressing anger inevitably makes strife. Provoke wrath and conflict must follow — a reason to check the mouth (30:32).
conflict — the inevitable yield of pressed anger
the strife that pressing anger produces — the conflict that follows as inevitably from provoked wrath as curds from churned milk, the guaranteed harvest of stirring up anger
the pressed anger that yields it (267264)
welded to the provoked wrath that produces it
rib (strife) — 'pressing anger produces STRIFE'; strife is the certain product of provoked anger. Stir the wrath and the quarrel is assured (cf 15:18; 29:22).
